purpose: evaluation only; no training, no tuning, no model/environment/reward change
evaluation_set: union of the three Stage 1D synthetic holdouts (never used for training or selection); exact duplicates of examined test-split rows excluded; exact duplicate rows within or across holdouts kept once
checkpoints: six multi-seed checkpoints (seeds 42/123/2026 x ENTROPY_COEF 0.0/0.005), selected on validation

cheapest_venue_outage.name: cheapest_venue_outage
cheapest_venue_outage.description: Fee-cheapest venue of each corridor at 10% liquidity.

combined_stress.name: combined_stress
combined_stress.description: Liquidity x0.7 and congestion x1.5 on all venues.

inference: two-level cluster bootstrap (checkpoints x simulation-date clusters), percentile 95% CI, two-sided bootstrap p; Holm-Bonferroni within each family (primary = H1-H4 on baseline; each stress scenario = its own family); Wilcoxon/sign on seed-averaged diffs as secondary
equivalence_margin_disclosure: Margins were chosen after Stage 1D holdout results were seen (observed projected-minus-waterfall spread -0.0033..+0.0051); they are fixed here before any Stage 1F evaluation.
stress_primary_metric: reward_amount (amount-based unrouted term), because the environment's unrouted accounting omits never-requested amounts, which matters when liquidity is short
